# wherdr

> Self-hosted web app and phone PWA to follow and drive the coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Devin, omp…) running in herdr-core (hc) on your machines, with built-in project management (a coordinator per project, a board, workflows, tasks to review) and Alfred, its assistant. Over localhost or a private network only. wherdr 3 installs from the v3 branch, beside wherdr 2. Open source, MIT.

## Docs

- [Setup guide for agents](https://wherdr.dev/agent.md): safety rules, what to detect, the install script's plan then `--yes`, the phone over Tailscale, updates
- [Install with an agent](https://github.com/afloury/wherdr/blob/v3/docs/install-with-an-agent.md): ready-to-paste prompts: new install, v3 beside an existing v2 with import, update
- [Installation and updates](https://github.com/afloury/wherdr/blob/v3/docs/installation.md): requirements (hc, Node.js 22, Git), `git clone -b v3` and `scripts/install-v3-beside-v2.sh` on Linux with systemd, by hand on macOS, updating with `update.sh` or Update with Alfred
- [Update with an agent](https://github.com/afloury/wherdr/blob/v3/docs/update-with-an-agent.md): plan, backup, update, health check, rollback
- [Release notes 3.0.0](https://github.com/afloury/wherdr/blob/v3/docs/release-notes-3.0.0.md): what v3 brings, what changed, what is gone
- [Migrate from v2](https://github.com/afloury/wherdr/blob/v3/docs/migrate-from-v2.md): v3 next to a running v2, import, fall back, uninstall
- [Documentation index](https://github.com/afloury/wherdr/blob/v3/docs/README.md): choose only the page relevant to the task
- [Security](https://github.com/afloury/wherdr/blob/v3/docs/security.md): network restrictions and passkeys
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/afloury/wherdr/blob/v3/docs/troubleshooting.md): common failures
- [Security policy](https://github.com/afloury/wherdr/blob/v3/SECURITY.md): how to report a vulnerability
